The source set validated at rho +0.73 (2026-08-18) carried the stimulus's own vocabulary at every scale point, because that is the anchor law: only stance may vary between the five statements. That makes the validated wording specific to the offer it was validated on. The placeholders below are the parts that were stimulus-bound. Fill them from YOUR offer before rating, keeping the register identical across all five statements of an axis. A filled set is DERIVED, not validated — the rho above does not transfer to your wording. Validate it with tools/validate.py before you trust a distribution. would_pay_at_price has no validated set and is collected as free text.
